name: Marek Voss
surface: A heavy-jawed sergeant in his late forties; greying at the temples, walks with a stiffness from an old hip wound.
want: keep his company alive through one more winter
need: stop measuring his worth by who he failed to bring home
ghost: commanded the rear-guard at the Coldfen rout; brought back seven of forty
lie: a captain who survives his men deserves what he gets
secret: he keeps a list of the thirty-three names in a folded scrap inside his coat
arcState: commands the fort; quiet since the last winter campaign

name: Roselle Vance
surface: A thin woman in her thirties with ink-stained fingers and a hood she keeps up indoors.
want: remain unrecognised in the towns she passes through
need: accept that her past is not an accusation she has to disprove
ghost: fled the abbey at Penholt the night the abbot was hanged
lie: if she stays still long enough, someone will come for her
secret: she carries a small enamelled icon she will not name, and a folded page from the abbot's last letter
arcState: recently completed a chain that confronted her past; she now carries a public title 'Reckoned With'

name: Tibalt Renn
surface: A wiry youth, twenty-two, with a habit of polishing his crossbow during conversations.
need: stop measuring himself against the older men
ghost: his older brother took the merc contract that should have been his and never came back
lie: surviving is a debt to be paid in service
secret: he keeps unsent letters to his brother folded into the lining of his crossbow case
arcState: recovering from a leg wound taken in the last contract

name: Gideon Harrow
surface: A balding man in his fifties with ink under his fingernails and a habit of counting under his breath.
want: see the fort's books balance through winter without selling reserves
need: stop hiding shortages from Marek out of misplaced loyalty
ghost: his last quartermaster post ended in a public audit that ruined two friends
lie: a quiet correction is kinder than a public truth
secret: he keeps a private duplicate of the seed-fund ledger in a binding the fort doesn't know about
arcState: managing the fort's books; quiet but watchful

name: Drust Halren
surface: Wiry, mid-thirties, a Greyford accent. Has not stopped offering deals since he was caught.
want: passage out of the region with no record of his name
need: stop trying to outlast every patience by trading scraps
ghost: his crew was caught because someone else's witness used his name
lie: every man has a price he can afford to pay
secret: a sewn list of barge contacts in his belt lining
arcState: held in the fort dungeon for three weeks; has not yet been sold or ransomed

name: Halvern Coate
surface: Heavyset, slick-haired, in his fifties; sweats easily.
want: secure Mireford's salt stores before winter without scandal
need: stop trusting the wrong intermediaries to keep his appearances intact
ghost: his predecessor was driven from office by a corruption inquiry he privately knew of
lie: a quiet bargain costs less than a public scandal
secret: a salt-invoice with a Tevin watermark hidden in his bedside drawer
arcState: in office, increasingly desperate; has begun making quiet requests of strangers

name: Abbess Lira Vesh
surface: A tall, severe woman of sixty, hands always folded.
want: shield the abbey from a crown audit that will ruin local families
need: trust that the families can survive the truth being told
ghost: she signed off on a relief consignment to a barge ring during the famine
lie: concealment is a form of mercy when the alternative is ruin
secret: a hidden iron-bound account book recording hush-payments behind a false binding
arcState: has been seen meeting with strangers at odd hours

name: Jorun Maerle
surface: A barrel-chested man in his forties with a Greyford burr and salt-cracked boots.
want: keep his harbour-master post and pay off his Greyford debt before the season ends
need: stop covering for ring couriers under the polite fiction of looking the other way
ghost: his son was hanged at Coldfen on a charge he believes was traded for someone else's clemency
lie: if he keeps his hands clean enough, no one can require him to choose a side
secret: a sealed Tevin chit promising next-season passage for his daughter in exchange for one looked-past barge
arcState: in office; visibly anxious during the last muster

name: Iselle Brun
surface: A slight, plainly-dressed woman in her late thirties, hair tied in a working knot. Easy to overlook.
want: consolidate Greyford as a quiet Tevin transfer point before any rival crew moves in
need: stop treating trust as a slow form of betrayal that always proves her right
ghost: her family was ruined when a former protector turned crown witness; she was twelve
lie: the only durable alliance is one where the other party has more to lose than you
secret: a false freight-license sewn into the keelboard of her flagship barge
arcState: slipped onto a barge during a fort raid last month; her whereabouts are not currently known

name: Father Renn Wend
surface: A spare, neatly-dressed priest in his late forties with a stiff back and a quiet voice.
want: secure an Ardren endorsement that would let him reclaim his cousin's small holding
need: stop laundering his ambition through the language of duty
ghost: his cousin's holding was seized after a witness Wend produced was later proved a forgery
lie: a small forgery in service of a true claim is not really a lie
secret: two forged Ardren endorsements folded into his breviary
arcState: has taken to walking the road to Vael's End at odd hours

name: Brann Olwyn
surface: A trim, white-haired man in his late fifties; wears his sleeves rolled when working.
want: see Lady Cessa's last weeks pass with dignity and the house in order
need: accept that quietly bearing a moral cost is not the same as paying it
ghost: co-signed a contract years ago that ended in a hanging he attended in silence
lie: honour kept in private is still honour
secret: a household ledger hidden in the binding of a hymnal, listing the names that contract took
arcState: still at Vael's End; Lady Cessa is fading

name: Captain Mar Holm
surface: A clean-shaven badger of a man in crown blue, fifties, never quite at ease without his writ-case.
want: secure a posting he believes was owed him after Vael's End is settled
need: stop using paperwork to avoid the moral weight of a decision
ghost: covered for a peer years ago who later got the posting Holm wanted
secret: a sealed writ authorising temporary seizure on ambiguous grounds
arcState: returning to Vael's End within the month

name: Sister Helle Brand
surface: A wiry sister in her late fifties; perpetually smelling faintly of smoke.
want: protect two cousins named in the abbey's ledgers from any official inquiry
need: stop substituting small destructions for the larger reckoning the abbey owes
ghost: she failed to speak up when an earlier confession was buried; the man hanged
lie: burning the page is gentler than letting the name be read aloud
secret: she has been quietly destroying entries in the abbey's account book for two years
arcState: still at the abbey; very tired

name: Lady Cessa Ardren
surface: A small white-haired woman in a Vael's End sickroom, eyes still sharp.
want: see her house pass to a successor she has named, not a crown-appointed steward
need: say aloud the name she has been writing in private letters for a decade
ghost: her chosen heir was disinherited after a forged endorsement she still does not know was forged
lie: the truth at the very end will be enough to set it right
secret: a folded page in her bed-bible naming her chosen successor and the abbot who witnessed it
arcState: in her last weeks; refusing visitors

name: Greyford Reach
surface: A slow elbow of grey water two leagues downriver from Mireford; one wooden mooring jetty, three barges typically tied up.
ghost: the site of a drowned-courier scandal three years ago
arcState: active mooring; harbour-master Jorun keeps his office here

name: Penholt Abbey
surface: A flint-and-mortar abbey two days east, a single bell tower visible from the road. Few visitors.
ghost: the abbot was hanged here ten years ago; the affair was never publicly resolved
arcState: Sister Helle and a half-dozen novices remain; archive intact

name: Vael's End
surface: A small stone keep on the headland north of Mireford; Ardren banner faded, gates kept ajar.
ghost: the Ardren line ends with Lady Cessa; succession disputed
arcState: steward Brann oversees daily affairs; Lady Cessa in sickroom

name: Slowwater Hamlet
surface: A six-cottage hamlet on a causeway through the southern marsh; reeds taller than a man.
ghost: the causeway has been closed before, the last time during a children's plague
